scope: 10 redesigns grounded in real CRM screenshots

concepts.name: Чистый минимализм
concepts.description: Crisp white and pale cool-gray canvas, confident cobalt blue primary, graphite text. Compact professional SaaS operations design, restrained thin borders, almost no shadows, 8px corners, tight useful spacing, precise small line icons, clear 44px table rows. Neat regular aligned grid. Neutral sidebar with a pale blue active row.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / screenshot-grounded redesign.
These attached images are ACTUAL screenshots of the user's existing 01 Academy CRM. Improve THIS interface's UI/UX into a polished coherent design concept. Do not invent a different product or a dashboard.
Image 1 is the PRIMARY edit target: the real sales Kanban page "Воронка продаж". Images 2-5 are supporting reference screenshots from the SAME existing application: academy overview, lesson calendar, clients table, and the existing MODAL lead Sheet. Use them only to understand shared components, typography, navigation, existing functionality and modal behavior.
Output ONE full desktop screenshot of an improved version of Image 1. Wide landscape 16:9. Flat straight-on high-resolution interface, crisp readable Cyrillic, no monitor hardware, no perspective, no presentation board, no collage and no additional small screenshots. Remove the browser's tabs/address/bookmark bars; show only the CRM application. Preserve the existing 01 Academy logo mark and wordmark.
Keep the recognizable existing structure and functionality: left module navigation, compact global header with search/theme/bell/messages/account controls, breadcrumb "Продажи", page title "Воронка продаж", funnel selector "Основная воронка", "Новая заявка", "Фильтры лидов", and the sales Kanban board. Preserve all visible stage headings in the same order: "Новый лид", "Ответственный назначен", "Недозвон", "Перезвонить позже". Preserve visible stage counts 113, 11 and 104. More stages remain reachable by horizontal scrolling. Each card retains its contact name/phone area, source badge such as Instagram or Meta Lead Ads, optional course badge, responsible manager, overflow menu, and the existing quick actions "Записать на демо-урок" and "Оплата". Preserve multi-select checkboxes and unread indicators. Keep the current sales navigation labels and all five business module groups, including finance and administration; improve grouping and compactness without removing sections.
Improve hierarchy, spacing, font sizing, legibility, board density, contrast, state colors, consistency of buttons and badges, and use of screen space. Show more useful card information with less repeated chrome. Existing lead/student/lesson details must still open in Dialog/Sheet overlays, never as an inline side panel. Do not show an open lead sheet in this pipeline screenshot. Do not add KPI cards, charts, fictional dashboards, AI assistants, new capabilities, technical explanations, help paragraphs or decorative illustrations.
Replace customer/employee personal names with clearly fictional sample names such as "Алексей К.", "Мария С.", "Даниил П.", "Елена В." and managers "Менеджер А." / "Менеджер Б.". Replace phone digits with masked "+998 •• ••• •• ••". Preserve their fields, positions and density. Never reproduce real phone numbers or contact names from inputs. All ordinary product UI labels must remain Russian, apart from existing brand/source/course names.
The image must visibly remain the user's real interface, comprehensively restyled and improved, not a generic template.
Requested visual direction for concept 01, "Чистый минимализм": Crisp white and pale cool-gray canvas, confident cobalt blue primary, graphite text. Compact professional SaaS operations design, restrained thin borders, almost no shadows, 8px corners, tight useful spacing, precise small line icons, clear 44px table rows. Neat regular aligned grid. Neutral sidebar with a pale blue active row.
Apply this direction to the ACTUAL screenshot's existing Kanban and shared shell. Return one redesigned sales pipeline screenshot only.

Restrained acid lime #C4EF64 only for active navigation, CTA and the primary graph. Minimal technical precision, compact dense controls, small 6px corners, hairline separators, tabular numeric typography, slim navigation. No glow, no colored gradients. Strong contrast.
